item.tib: yon tan can gyi gdung la zhabs tog dbul tshul
item.coloph: rtsa ba'i lha grogs rin chen lhun 'grub ming gis bskul ba la brten nas/ thos med sgrin bu kun shes khas len pa'i/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bdag gis sbyar ba la/ nor 'khrul log mchis skyabs yul mchog la bshags/ dge ba'i 'gro rnams thar pa'i lam bsgrod shog dge'o//
